role: The comparator (149 unpowered, 150 powered) with its TileEntityComparator output: compare or subtract mode, input from power or a container's fill level, and the output signal.
scope_reason: In scope: comparators are craftable (Nether quartz) and placeable; the oracle toggles the mode on right-click, and because func_149903_h reads a container's comparator override directly instead of World's power queries, a comparator behind a filled chest, furnace or hopper still lights and stores an output signal with redstone = off.

members.name: getIcon
members.note: the oracle dumps getIcon for every (id, meta, side) into rb_table.icon_index; table_icon reads it

members.name: func_149970_j
members.note: the input, less the side input in subtract mode

members.name: func_149900_a
members.note: 15 and up powers, 0 does not, else against the side input

members.name: func_149903_h
members.note: the override of the block behind (chest and double chest, trapped chest, furnace, dispenser, dropper, hopper, brewing stand, cauldron, jukebox, end portal frame) or behind a normal cube there: rs-cmp-s1 reads each, one furnace through a stone

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: mode flip with flags 2 then func_149972_c

members.name: func_149897_b
members.note: skipped while its tick waits in this tick's batch (WorldServer.func_147477_a, ticks.c ticks_scheduled_this_tick); otherwise a tick two ahead, priority -1 behind another diode, when the input or the powered bit moved

members.name: func_149972_c
members.note: the output stored, the powered bit (flag 2) and func_149911_e; activate.c keeps the right-click's copy

members.name: updateTick
members.note: servertick.c update_tick's case 149/150: the powered form reverts (flag 4), then func_149972_c

members.name: onBlockAdded
members.note: diode_notify; the TE is created by the world core on demand

members.name: onBlockEventReceived
members.note: no block event is ever added for a comparator, and TileEntityComparator does not override receiveClientEvent

notes: The container-input caveat means redstone = off does not fully freeze comparators in the oracle. No recording is known to place a comparator against a filled container. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/idxredstone 2026-09-27: exact. world.conf redstone = off zeroes only World's power queries, so the container input stays live: comparator.c ports it with World.func_147453_f (called from setBlock and setBlockMetadataWithNotify flag 1, the containers' breakBlock, TileEntity.onInventoryChanged in the window clicks, the furnace, the cauldron, the jukebox, the ender eye and dev tile data). rs-cmp-s1: comparators placed by hand behind eleven containers, a chest filled and emptied through its window, the furnace smelting, a cauldron filled, a record in and out, an eye set, a double chest, a trapped chest opened, the mode toggled, a chest broken, the solid block between a furnace and its comparator removed, a comparator dug. Java calls func_147453_f at each markDirty of a click; native once per click that changed a tile slot, which leaves the same pending ticks (only NextTickListEntry's id counter moves less; no row carries it).
